description: Presidential Secretariat -  Appoint the persons as members of the Panel of Industrial Courts to the period of three years from 13.06.2017
categorisation: This gazette content involves the appointment of members to the Industrial Courts panel by the President under the Industrial Disputes Act. While it contains personnel appointments (names), these are specifically judicial/law enforcement appointments (industrial court members who are attorneys-at-law and former labour officials) rather than general government ministerial/personnel changes. The content falls under judicial matters and law enforcement administration, making it Type 9 (Judicial/Law Enforcement) rather than a government personnel type.
